summary: Verified SVG clipping bug fix in HowItWorks recirculation loop. Navigated to Process section, inspected path d-attributes and bounding boxes via DOM, confirmed loop stays within viewBox (right-most x = 976.12, viewBox is 0-1000). Both left and right curves render fully, symmetric, no clipping. Animated sponge balls still moving (12 SVG circles found). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: bezier control points moved from (width+40) to (width-10), keeping path max x at 990 (inside viewBox width 1000). Confirmed via getBBox: right edge = 976.12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HowItWorks SVG recirculation loop fix verified. Path d uses width-10 as bezier control; renders correctly within viewBox 0-1000. Animation and nav 'Process' link functional.
rca of the issue: Original bezier used control point x = width+40 = 1040, outside viewBox 0-1000; parent wrapper has overflow-hidden clipping the overflow. Fix pulls control points to width-10, bending curve inward while preserving visual loop shape.
